note: Window: 8 quarterly equity calls Q1 FY27 back to Q2 FY25, all held and opened. Separate fixed-income/debt calls exist for Q4 FY26 (and possibly other quarters); these were used only as outcome evidence, not as promise sources. Override test (backbone §4 SEVERE: could permanently impair capital, end a revenue stream, or make reported numbers unreliable) was applied to every contradicted class-10 assurance. Each one concerned Khavda evacuation or curtailment, at about 5-14% of generation or EBITDA, and none met the test, so no call was forced to 0. Page numbers follow the 'N | P a g e' or 'Page X of Y' headers. The Q1 FY26 PDF carries no page headers, so the speaker and section are cited instead. Quotes come from WebFetch extraction of the filed PDFs and are excerpts; the transcripts carry the company's transcription-error disclaimer. Rule 6: no Reg. 30 impact-statement items in the file; none removed. Rule-7 convention: year-specific targets are traced to the earliest year-specific statement; generic run-rates ('3 GW a year', Q4 FY22; '5 plus GW year-on-year', Q2 FY24) are noted, not treated as origins. v1.2 rule-7 re-grade: 9 promises moved to outside_window origins, 5 more consolidated in-window; 4 outside_window calls added (Q1 FY25, Q4 FY24, Q3 FY24, Q1 FY24); FY25/FY26 capacity, evacuation, 2030/Khavda/PSP/Chitravathi targets moved; FY26 capacity now 0 (cut 6→5 GW, no reason); call grades Q2 FY26 1.0→0.8, Q1 FY26 1.2→1.3, Q4 FY25 1.7→1.5, Q3 FY25 0.8→1.3, Q2 FY25 0.3→1.0; score missing (4.0 on old grades) → 4.1.
